methodologyNotes: Re-verified against official/live sources on 2026-06-15. Shopify App Store listings (apps.shopify.com/returns-center-by-aftership, /returngo, /rich-returns, /yayloh, /postco360, /loop-returns) and the AfterShip Returns help-center pricing article were fetched directly and confirm the stated tiers. ReturnLogic ($299/mo minimum, usage-based) confirmed via official pricing page + FAQ. Loop Advanced shows a real cross-source discrepancy ($340 on the Shopify listing that governs Shopify-merchant billing vs $272 on loopreturns.com/pricing); the live Shopify price is used as primary and the discrepancy is noted. Narvar and parcelLab confirmed quote/demo-only with no published pricing (monthlyUsd null). Returnly (Affirm) confirmed shut down 1 Oct 2023 and excluded. Corrections from the draft: removed an unverified 20% annual discount on Rich Returns (no annual option on the Shopify listing); removed an unverified 14-day yayloh app trial and an unverified yayloh GDPR claim (no live page corroboration). AfterShip 7-day trial, Return Care $0 merchant plan, and SOC2/ISO27001/GDPR all confirmed. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: AfterShip Returns
vendors.provenance: Pricing verified on the AfterShip Returns help-center pricing article (support.aftership.com/.../1nleek9), which lists Essentials $9 annual / $11 monthly, Pro $49/$59, Premium $199/$239 and 'up to 18% savings' annually. The Shopify App Store listing shows a different simplified two-tier set (Essentials $19, Premium $119 with a $1-first-month teaser) plus the free shopper-funded Return Care plan; the help-center article is authoritative for web/non-Shopify pricing. Compliance (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR) confirmed on the AfterShip Trust Centre.

plans.name: Return Care
plans.notes: Shopper-funded returns model — merchant pays $0/month; shoppers pay a small fee at checkout to unlock free return labels. Verified as a real free-to-install plan on the AfterShip Returns Shopify App Store listing. No return volume cap listed.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: $9/month billed annually or $11/month billed monthly (240 returns/year). Overage $0.50 per extra return. Branded returns page, automatic approvals, refunds/exchanges, eligibility rules, analytics. Verified on help-center article.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $49/month billed annually or $59/month billed monthly (1,200 returns/year). Overage $0.50 per extra return. Adds automation, in-app tracking, store credit.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $199/month billed annually or $239/month billed monthly (2,400 returns/year). Overage $1.00 per extra return. Adds full workflow automation, anti-fraud workflows, pre-built integrations.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom volume-based pricing. Large-scale customization, APIs, POS support, dedicated account management.

limits: Unused returns do not carry forward
keyFeatures: Return Care zero-cost merchant model with shopper-funded labels
SOC 2 Type II + ISO 27001 + GDPR (per Trust Centre)
bestFor: Shopify merchants wanting a zero-cost model via Return Care
enrichment.provenance: Pricing confirmed on AfterShip Returns help-center article; Return Care $0 plan and Shopify two-tier set confirmed on the Shopify listing; SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR confirmed on the Trust Centre.

vendors.name: ReturnGO
vendors.provenance: Pricing verified on the ReturnGO Shopify App Store listing (apps.shopify.com/returngo): Starter $23, Premium $147, Pro $297, all with a 14-day trial. Integrations from returngo.ai/integrations/.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 20 returns/month included. Overage $1.25 per additional return. Full returns solution, variant exchange, return labels, unlimited policy rules, store credit, auto-approval, 2 languages, email notifications. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: 110 returns/month included. Overage $1.25 per additional return. Adds product exchange, Shop Now, white-label portal, item donation, shipping integrations, AI-powered store credit. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 300 returns/month included. Overage $0.90 per additional return. Adds advanced automation, packing slips, item validation, ERP integrations, unlimited languages, advanced analytics, API access. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Up to 5,000 annual returns baseline. Order tracking portal, advanced automations, multi-store, omni-channel, dedicated account manager. Supports non-Shopify platforms.

keyFeatures: Wide carrier network including regional carriers
enrichment.provenance: Pricing confirmed exactly on the Shopify App Store listing; integrations from the official ReturnGO integrations page.

vendors.name: Rich Returns
vendors.provenance: Pricing verified on the Shopify App Store listing (apps.shopify.com/rich-returns): Standard $19, Pro $39, Premium $99, Enterprise Plus $199, all with a 30-day free trial. The listing shows no annual billing option, so the previously-claimed 20% annual discount has been removed (set to null).

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: 10 returns/month included; $1.00 per extra return. Branded portal, automated prepaid labels, multi-language emails, 6+ integrations. 30-day free trial.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 50 returns/month included; $0.75 per extra return. Adds variant exchanges, resolution hub, advanced analytics, CSV export, multi-language portal. 30-day free trial.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: 100 returns/month included; $0.50 per extra return. Adds advanced rules, auto-refunds, automatic exchange orders, store credit automation. 30-day free trial.

plans.name: Enterprise Plus
plans.notes: 500+ returns/month (scalable). Adds custom domain, international labels, QR code labels, audit log, API access, auto-tracking, store-wide exchanges. 30-day free trial.

keyFeatures: Longest free trial in category (30 days)
Declining per-return overage fees as tier increases
International return labels on Enterprise tier
bestFor: Small Shopify merchants wanting a low entry price
enrichment.provenance: Prices and 30-day trial confirmed on the Shopify App Store listing; fabricated 20% annual discount removed because the Shopify listing exposes no annual billing option.

vendors.name: yayloh
vendors.provenance: Tier names and prices verified on the Shopify App Store listing (apps.shopify.com/yayloh): Start Bright $150, Grow Smarter $250, Scale Faster $490. The yayloh.com/pricing page (which the draft noted returned 403) could not be re-verified; the previously-claimed 14-day app trial and GDPR statement are unconfirmed and have been set to null.

plans.name: Start Bright
plans.notes: Branded digital return form, automated exchanges, email notifications, shipping label generation, analytics dashboard. Quarterly/annual billing also offered. No published per-tier volume cap. Charged by Tectry Software AB separately from the Shopify invoice.

plans.name: Grow Smarter
plans.notes: All Start Bright features plus return tracking page, SMS notifications, refund fee deduction rules, advanced branding, prioritized support. Annual overages charged per 10 returns beyond cap.

plans.name: Scale Faster
plans.notes: All Grow Smarter features plus full automation based on return status, multi-warehouse setup, advanced return fees by carrier, dedicated account manager. Annual overages charged per 10 returns beyond cap.

limits: No published per-month return cap; annual overage charged per 10 returns beyond the fixed annual number
keyFeatures: Annual overage model (not monthly), reducing mid-season billing surprises
bestFor: Shopify merchants with seasonal return spikes
enrichment.provenance: Tier names and prices confirmed exactly on the Shopify App Store listing; unverified 14-day trial and GDPR claims removed pending a live yayloh.com source.

vendors.name: ReturnLogic
vendors.provenance: Verified on returnlogic.com/pricing/ and the FAQ: usage-based per-return model starting at a $299/month minimum, per-return $3.90 down to $0.25 by volume, 12-month contract, no free trial. Named Growth/Pro tiers cited by third parties are not on the official page and remain excluded.

plans.name: Usage Based
plans.notes: Starts at $299/month minimum. Per-return pricing $3.90 down to $0.25 depending on volume tier. 12-month contract, billed annually or monthly, auto-renews unless 30 days' notice. No free trial. Includes advanced reporting, instant exchanges, bonus credit, disposition management, automated rules.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Everything in Usage Based plus dedicated CSM, quarterly returns reports, white-label domains, complete portal customization, dedicated returns analyst. 12-month contract.

limits: Per-return cost drops from $3.90 to $0.25 at scale
keyFeatures: Volume-tiered per-return pricing (cost drops at scale)
bestFor: Mid-market brands with high and variable return volumes
Merchants who want cost to scale with returns
enrichment.provenance: Confirmed on the official ReturnLogic pricing page and FAQ; $299/month minimum and no-free-trial both explicitly stated.

vendors.name: Postco
vendors.provenance: Pricing verified on the Shopify App Store listing (apps.shopify.com/postco360): Checkout+ free-to-install (customer-funded), Pro $129 (up to 100 returns/mo), Premium $239 (up to 200 returns/mo), 14-day trial on paid tiers. The official postco.co/pricing page returns 403, so the Shopify listing is primary.

plans.name: Checkout+
plans.notes: Free to install. Customer-funded returns — shoppers pay for return shipping at checkout. Zero merchant subscription fee. Includes all Premium features, order editing, cart/checkout upsell, EU withdrawal portal. No stated volume cap.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Up to 100 returns/month. 2 return locations, unlimited carrier accounts, in-app exchange, international returns, instant exchange with AI agent. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Up to 200 returns/month. All Pro features plus website exchanges for multiple items, exchange upsells, bonus credit incentives, 3PL integrations, questions and insights. 14-day free trial.

limits: Checkout+ has no stated volume cap
keyFeatures: AI agent for instant exchange decisions
Exchange upsells to drive revenue on returns
bestFor: Shopify merchants wanting a zero-cost model
European brands needing EU withdrawal compliance
enrichment.provenance: Prices confirmed exactly on the Shopify App Store listing (official postco.co/pricing returns 403).

vendors.name: Loop Returns
vendors.provenance: Pricing verified on both sources: the Shopify App Store listing (apps.shopify.com/loop-returns) shows Free $0, Essential $155, Advanced $340; the official loopreturns.com/pricing page shows Essential $155, Advanced $272, Enterprise custom, and no free plan. The Shopify listing is used as primary because it governs actual billing for Shopify-native merchants; the $272 figure is noted as a live discrepancy. SOC 2 and GDPR confirmed on loopreturns.com/security.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Returns software, US/Canada domestic return labels, Return Bars, package protection. Shown on the Shopify App Store listing only (the official pricing page lists no free plan). Shopify-only. No stated volume cap.

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: Unlimited destinations, automated return policies, carrier rate shopping, workflows, order editing, store credit and refunds, gift returns, label customization, insights, fraud detection. Bundle with Loop Tracking for 10% off. $155/mo on both the Shopify listing and loopreturns.com/pricing.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: All Essential plus Shop Now, Instant Exchange, Bonus Credit, store credit incentives, advanced exchanges (Keep Item, cross-border, bundles), dynamic fees, dedicated support, performance reviews. $340/mo on the Shopify App Store listing (billing-authoritative for Shopify merchants); loopreturns.com/pricing lists $272/mo for this tier.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Adds Instant Returns, enterprise shipping integrations, Merchant Success Manager, dedicated support. Targets brands with 2,000+ annual returns.

limits: Free plan: US/Canada domestic labels only (Shopify listing only)
Advanced: requires Stripe for Instant Exchange
Advanced price differs by source: $340 (Shopify) vs $272 (official site)
enrichment.provenance: Free/Essential/Advanced prices confirmed on the Shopify App Store listing; $272 Advanced figure noted from the official site; SOC 2 and GDPR confirmed on loopreturns.com/security.

vendors.name: Narvar
vendors.provenance: Confirmed quote/demo-only: corp.narvar.com/return-exchange publishes no pricing and routes to 'Request a demo.' No public tiers; monthlyUsd null.

plans.name: Enterprise (custom)
plans.notes: Quote-only. Pricing based on order volume, feature modules (tracking, returns, Shield fraud detection), and geographic reach. Annual contracts only. Illustrative third-party benchmark only: ~$0.49/return at 100,000 returns/year; full-suite annual cost can exceed $250,000. No published pricing.

limits: Annual contracts only, no monthly option
keyFeatures: Exchange-driven revenue retention per Narvar benchmark
bestFor: Enterprise retailers with high order volume
Brands needing bundled tracking + returns platform
enrichment.provenance: Confirmed quote/demo-only via Narvar's returns product page; no public pricing published.

vendors.name: parcelLab
vendors.provenance: Confirmed quote-only: parcelLab publishes no pricing for its Retain returns product and routes to 'Book a demo.' Returns solution branded 'parcelLab Retain.' monthlyUsd null.

plans.name: Enterprise (custom)
plans.notes: Quote-only. Pricing based on annual shipping volume, carrier count, and modules selected (Convert, Engage, Retain). Implementation typically 2-4 months. No self-serve or standard tiers.

limits: Enterprise only — no SMB self-serve tiers
keyFeatures: parcelLab Retain: embeddable self-service return portal
bestFor: Enterprise retailers with complex multi-carrier needs
Brands wanting a unified post-purchase + returns platform
enrichment.provenance: No public pricing exists; quote-only confirmed via the absence of any pricing page and demo-only routing. Features from official parcelLab documentation.
